claims.text: Niraparib docks to human PARP1 (PDB 4R6E) with a Vina score of -10.178 kcal/mol (co-crystal redocking control).
The US label for niraparib (ZEJULA) includes thrombocytopenia in the Warnings and Precautions and Adverse Reactions sections.
FAERS data show a disproportionate reporting of thrombocytopenia with niraparib (PRR 9.13, 95% CI 8.61–9.69).
A PubMed case report describes severe thrombocytopenia induced by niraparib in ovarian cancer patients (PMID 40687421).

summary: Niraparib is predicted to bind PARP1 with a Vina score of -10.178 kcal/mol, and human evidence shows thrombocytopenia is a known risk: it appears in the US label, is disproportionately reported in FAERS, and is described in case reports.
